summary: CMS content endpoints (GET /api/content, PUT /api/admin/content) fully tested + regression on prior endpoints. 21/21 new tests pass; 42/42 prior tests still pass. Content restored to seed defaults at module teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1080 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline limit. Consider splitting into routers (content_router.py, admin_router.py, public_router.py).

PUT /api/admin/content does a top-level $set per provided section, which OVERWRITES the entire section. If frontend sends only one sub-key (e.g. {hero: {badge: 'x'}}), all other hero keys would be wiped. Current FE seems to send full section objects, but a deep-merge or sub-key-level whitelist would be safer.

Whitelist check is correct for top-level keys, but no shape validation per section (could store arbitrary types under e.g. comparison.rows). Consider Pydantic per-section models if richer validation is needed.
seed_data_creation: None — used auto-fixture to snapshot existing content, mutate during tests, restore at module teardown. Verified post-run that hero.badge, footer.tagline, and essential.featureBullets all match seed defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Content CMS is solid. New regression file at tests/test_content_cms.py covers: 11 sections present, _id/id omission, 401/400 error paths, partial updates, whitelist of unknown keys, round-trip of comparison.rows + essential.featureBullets, audit log entry creation (verified via GET /api/admin/audit), and regression on /api/reviews, /api/faqs, /api/store, /api/subscriptions, /api/admin/analytics. Audit endpoint is /api/admin/audit (NOT /api/admin/audit-logs).
